summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Epersonel site. 18/18 backend pytest tests pass (health, auth login/logout/me, lead create/list/update/assign, references CRUD). Frontend: all 8 public pages (/, /ep, /epapp, /epfood, /epkurye, /referanslar, /hakkimizda, /iletisim) load with 0 console errors, no 'Giriş Yap' button in any header. EP page renders correctly post-Cheese->Sandwich fix; all 6 sector chips (Market, Kasap, Manav, Şarküteri, Petshop, Su Bayii) visible; EP Plus pricing present. Çözümler mega menu opens on hover with correct order EP -> EPapp -> EPfood -> EPkurye. Reference marquee renders. Contact form full flow works: dependent İl/İlçe dropdown populates (İstanbul -> 40 ilçe including Kadıköy), POST /api/leads returns 201, success message 'Talebiniz alındı.' shown. Admin login works with provided credentials, dashboard lists leads including the UI-submitted test lead, references tab present. Mobile 375px: hamburger visible, no horizontal overflow. All imagery is logo/dashboard-mockup style, no stock photos detected.

minor.issue: Response items include 'logo_path' internal storage path. Not sensitive but could be omitted from public payload (only 'logo_url' is used by UI).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 950+ lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, leads, references, admin) for maintainability.

LeadForm.jsx uses local /app/frontend/src/data/il-ilce.json for city/district data (review request mentioned /api/locations/cities endpoint which does not exist; current local-JSON approach works fine and is faster, but description in review may be outdated).
seed_admin correctly updates password on env change (verified via login test); uses bcrypt hash — good.
CSV export uses ; delimiter with BOM for Excel compatibility — good.
Login sets httpOnly secure cookies with SameSite=none — good for cross-site; verify prod domain uses HTTPS (already does).
seed_data_creation: Created test leads via API and UI with business_name prefixed TEST_QA (TEST_QA Market, TEST_QA UI Market) and one TEST_Ref_* reference via admin API. Not cleaned up — main agent may leave or purge as needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BRANCH_OPTIONS uses en-dash '–' not hyphen '-' (e.g., '2–5 Şube') — critical for lead payloads. LeadForm testid pattern: '{form-id}-business-input', '-branch-select', '-contact-input', '-phone-input', '-email-input', '-il-select', '-ilce-select', '-kvkk-checkbox', '-submit'. Contact form uses id 'contact-lead-form'. Admin login testids: 'admin-login-email-input', 'admin-login-password-input', 'admin-login-submit'. pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope so class-scoped state is safe within one class.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Previous Cheese->Sandwich fix verified: /ep loads clean, Şarküteri chip renders with icon.
